# Design System

A Figma-to-code design system with an interactive showcase website for vibe coding designers.

## Packages
- tokens: Design tokens (colors, spacing, typography) extracted from Figma
- components: React component library built on top of tokens
- icons: SVG icon library as React components

## App
- docs: Interactive website showcasing all components with live previews and code snippets

## Key conventions
- Import components from packages/components
- Import tokens from packages/tokens/dist
- Never use hardcoded values — always use tokens
- Component structure: primitives (atoms) → patterns (composed components)
